name: BRAND TEXT
description:
The sleek and modern saunas sold by Precision Therapy Saunas are a pleasure to use. Their flagship two person infrared sauna cabin fits in many small corners in the house. It is comfortable for two and luxurious for a single person as they can stretch out and relax while enjoying the health benefits offered by this infrared sauna range.



Precision Therapy Saunas have designed their saunas to ensure maximum relaxation; a magazine holder keeps your reading on hand and the high spec music system allows you to personalise your playlist to maximise your mood while you relax and enjoy the health benefits of this infrared sauna.



Precision Therapy Saunas also come with some clever design features. For instance, the internal lighting panel lets you change the light colour and intensity to your preference while the external lights will add ambience and style to any room in the home. All Precision Therapy Sauna’s come with electric ionisers to keep the air in your infrared sauna fresh and clean and can be turned on or off during or after your sauna based on your preference. Finally, the touch panels are easy to use and the heating can be timed to turn on in 0-60 minutes allowing for convenience.
